question.text: Numbers are to be formed between <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1000</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3000</mn></math>, which are divisible by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn></math>, using the digits <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn></math> without repetition of digits. Then the total number of such numbers is _______.

solution.text:
To find total numbers between 1000 and 3000 divisible by 4 using the digits 1,2,3,4,5,6,

We will solve in two cases.

Case I : When first digit is 1.

Then last two digits can be 24,32,36,52,56 or 64

So, total ways of choosing last two digit is 6 and second digit will be chosen in 3 ways

So, number of such numbers =6×3=18

Case II: When first digit is 2

Then last two digits can be 16,36,56 or 64

So, total ways of choosing last two digit is 4 and second digit will be chosen in 3 

So, number of such numbers =4×3=12

Total numbers of numbers =18+12=30
